verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents automation features like event-triggered onboarding/offboarding, conditional-access revocation, and identity lifecycle automation that run without manual intervention (jumpcloud-docs-7,11,17,20,24), plus APIs/PowerShell for bulk automation (jumpcloud-docs-3,19). However, none of this is framed as AI-native/agentic automation that a user configures for autonomous background execution—it's traditional IT policy automation, not agent-orchestrated workflows. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent automation builder, autonomous task scheduling by AI agents, and any agentic workflow framework or third-party corroboration of such use.
